title: Introduce claims entropy normalizer and residency heuristics for KMS routing
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Adds server-side claim entropy normalization to stabilize residency routing decisions; KMS residency heuristics reduce cross-region key usage and instrument audit logs with routing rationale; RBAC updates prevent privilege escalation via high-entropy tenant claims.
description: Motivation: We observed intermittent cross-region KMS usage in multi-tenant workloads when high-entropy or malformed tenant claims caused residency classifiers to flip decisions. That led to unnecessary key wrapping across regions and spurious audit entries. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: (1) a claims entropy normalizer that compresses and canonicalizes tenant-provided identity attributes before they hit residency/GEO classifiers, and (2) a residency heuristics module that prefers co-located CMKs when the normalized claim confidence exceeds a configurable threshold. The changes are implemented server-side in the KMS routing pipeline and guarded by feature flags for staged rollout. Key features: - Claims entropy normalizer: deterministic canonicalization + bloom-derived entropy score used to downweight noisy attributes (e.g., long free-form notes, concatenated identifiers). Normalizer exposes an entropy_score (0-100) attached to the routing decision context. - Residency heuristics: a pluggable policy that computes a residency_score combining normalized claim confidence, request geography, and historical residency evidence; prefers local CMKs when residency_score >= configurable threshold (default 0.8). - Audit enrichment: every KMS routing decision now records routing_reason and entropy_score in immutable audit envelopes (preserving backwards-compatible envelope format). - RBAC adjustments: tighten operator-scoped write bindings that previously allowed claim mutation mid-flow; added a short-lived policy that denies claim-mutating actions from non-owner operators when entropy_score > 60. - Config / rollout: feature flags kms.claims_normalizer.enabled and kms.residency_heuristics.enabled; threshold kms.residency_heuristics.local_preference_threshold (default 0.8). Rollout plan: stage 1 (internal): enable normalizer for 25% of traffic with heuristic off to collect entropy telemetry; stage 2 (beta): enable heuristics in canary region with threshold set to 0.85; stage 3 (global): gradual ramp and SDS configuration updates for Dedicated/Private. Testing & validation: unit tests for normalization determinism and entropy scoring; integration tests simulating edge-case claims and asserting local CMK selection; load tests to ensure no latency regression in hot paths. Backwards compatibility: audit envelopes keep legacy fields; routing_reason added as optional attribute. Related work: ENG-1129 (residency classifier hardening), SEC-204 (claims integrity audit).
